bullets.text: PMK president Anbumani Ramadoss alleged a massive scam involving officials attempting to dilute safeguards for the Pallikaranai marshland to favour real estate developers.
Commuters faced a five-hour power outage near Periyapalayam, leading to a road blockade by the public on the Chennai-Tirupati highway that caused traffic disruptions.
The meteorological department predicted very heavy rain today in Chennai, Chengalpattu, Kancheepuram, and Thiruvallur districts, requiring vigilance from local disaster response teams.
Severe traffic congestion was reported on the Velachery 100 Feet Road, and the constituency team should monitor local transit bottlenecks and coordinate relief measures.
A road in Ambattur Ayapakkam was flooded with rainwater, forcing a local resident to struggle through the water to search for a lost mobile phone.
Data revealed that 81 people lost their eyesight due to firecrackers during the recent Diwali festival, showing an increase compared to previous years.
Following media reports from Dinamalar, a yoga and naturopathy lifestyle center building was officially opened in Tiruttani to serve the local public.
The Tamil Nadu government and IIT Madras signed an MoU at the Secretariat to establish a dedicated Artificial Intelligence Data Centre and Project Monitoring Unit.
Vultr launched a 20 MW artificial intelligence supercluster in Chennai, marking a significant milestone for Tamil Nadu's digital infrastructure landscape.
BJP leader L. Murugan responded to questions regarding whether opposition parties were attempting horse-trading with TVK MLAs.
The TVK IT Wing raised sharp questions against the DMK regarding controversies surrounding books purchased for the Periyar Arignar Ulagam.
The Kerala Law Academy Law College invited research papers for its 33rd International Seminar focusing on good governance and artificial intelligence in the digital era.
